validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED. This is one of the twin 36-inch export trunklines of Saudi Aramco's Al Wasit Gas Program, carrying sour non-associated gas from the offshore Arabiyah and Hasbah fields (~150 km NE of Jubail, Arabian Gulf, water depths to 65 m) to the onshore Wasit Gas Plant near Jubail. Independent, non-GEM corroboration: offshore-technology's Al Wasit Gas Program and Hasbah Gas Field Expansion project pages, and Oil & Gas Journal's Hasbah commissioning article all describe 'twin 36-in. trunklines' delivering a combined 2.5 bscfd to Wasit; OGJ dates commissioning to March 2016 and offshore-technology dates first gas to October 2015. Correctly a gas TRANSMISSION/export trunk (not gathering/process/plant-internal, not oil/NGL). DUPLICATE CHECK: P7766 (Pipeline 1) and P7767 (Pipeline 2) are the two physically distinct parallel trunklines of the same program, NOT a mutual double-count, so both should stay. The sheet has no gem.wiki page for this row. GulfPub PE World Map has NO Hasbah/Wasit/Arabiyah counterpart in its 20-feature Saudi gas roster; the auto-flagged fuzzy matches ('Qatif - Berri Pipeline' and 'Jafurah Gas Plant to Riyas') are FALSE POSITIVES (different fields, different endpoints, different status) and should be disregarded.

validity.researcher_notes: MULTIPLE SPEC/DATE PROBLEMS. (1) CAPACITY: sheet shows Capacity=1.00 MMcf/d, which is an obvious placeholder/error for an 80 km, 36-inch offshore trunkline. The program's combined design throughput is 2.5 bscfd (=2,500 MMcf/d) from both fields across the twin trunklines (offshore-technology, OGJ), so a per-line figure is on the order of ~1,000-1,250 MMcf/d, but no source gives an authoritative single-line capacity, so I am NOT staging a hard number (Capacity is a weak field). Recommend blanking the 1.00 placeholder rather than leaving it. (2) LENGTH: sheet shows 80 km. Sources describe the offshore export pipeline as 260 km (36-in), plus ~120 km onshore, ~380 km total system; the fields sit ~150 km NE of Jubail. GEM's 80 km/line is materially understated and unsourced by the corroborating material (its current Length ref, an Aramco Fadhili page, timed out and is the wrong project anyway). Flagging as a length conflict; not overwriting because per-line splits are not cleanly stated. (3) START YEAR: sheet shows StartYear1=2017. Independent sources place first gas in Oct 2015 (offshore-technology) and commissioning in March 2016 (OGJ) — 2017 is too late. Recommend 2015 (or 2016). DIAMETER=36 in is CONFIRMED (twin 36-in trunklines; offshore-technology + OGJ agree).

validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION mostly correct. Owner/operator = Saudi Aramco (owns and operates the Wasit Gas Program) — CONFIRMED. FuelSource = 'Hasbah Gas Field': accurate but incomplete — the twin trunklines carry gas from BOTH the Arabiyah AND Hasbah offshore fields to Wasit (the program is jointly 'Arabiyah & Hasbah'). Minor caveat; adding 'Arabiyah Gas Field' would be more complete. Endpoints on the sheet ('Persian Gulf' -> 'Wasit') are directionally right but vague; see routes object for named endpoints.

routes.corridor_desc: Offshore export trunkline running SW from the Hasbah/Arabiyah field complex in the Arabian Gulf (water depths to 65 m, ~150 km NE of Jubail) to a coastal landfall near Jubail, then onshore to the Wasit Gas Plant in/near the Jubail industrial area, Eastern Province. Sources give ~260 km offshore + ~120 km onshore for the system. Corridor is loosely bounded: field location and destination plant are well sourced, but the exact subsea routing and landfall point are not published, so endpoint coordinates are DERIVED approximations (Hasbah from 'water depth to 65 m, ~150 km NE of Jubail'; Wasit plant from 'in the Jubail industrial city' near Khursaniyah 27.22N,49.22E). Not survey-grade.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources naming the Hasbah/Arabiyah offshore fields (~150 km NE of Jubail, Arabian Gulf) and the onshore Wasit Gas Plant near Jubail. Coordinates are DEFENSIBLE APPROXIMATIONS derived from those named locations, NOT fabricated survey points: Hasbah ~27.9N/50.7E is projected ~150 km NE from Jubail (27.0N,49.66E); Wasit plant ~27.05N/49.62E is the Jubail industrial area. Exact subsea alignment and landfall are unpublished, hence suggested accuracy 'low'. No coordinate invented beyond what the named places defensibly support.

summary: P7766 Hasbah-Wasit Pipeline 1 is REAL and correctly classed (one of Aramco's twin 36-in Wasit-program export trunklines, Arabiyah+Hasbah -> Wasit) but has spec/date errors: Capacity=1.0 MMcf/d placeholder, Length 80 km understated (offshore export ~260 km), StartYear 2017 wrong (first gas Oct 2015 / commissioned Mar 2016); Diameter 36 confirmed; not a duplicate of P7767 (genuine twin line); no GulfPub counterpart.
